appearance_facts.fact: The chart is titled 'Incidence of Condition A in US States'.
It is a choropleth map of the United States.
States are colored in a gradient from light yellow to dark red.
The legend on the right is labeled 'High' at the top and 'Low' at the bottom.
The legend uses a color scale ranging from 0 to 100, with 100 at the top (dark red) and 0 at the bottom (light yellow).
California (CA) is colored dark red, indicating the highest incidence value.
Tennessee (TN) is colored light yellow, indicating the lowest incidence value.
Delaware (DE) is colored medium orange, indicating a moderate incidence value.

printed_facts.fact: The legend indicates that darker colors correspond to higher incidence values.
California (CA) is the state with the darkest color on the map, corresponding to the highest incidence value.
Tennessee (TN) is the state with the lightest color on the map, corresponding to the lowest incidence value.
Delaware (DE) is colored a medium shade of orange, indicating a moderate incidence value.
